titleOriginal: CesiumAstro, which plans a 737-satellite LEO communications network at two altitudes, raised $730M at a $4.5B+ valuation, bringing its total funding to $1.4B (Loren Grush/Bloomberg)
summary: CesiumAstra筹集730万美元融资，估值4.5亿美元以上。总融资额达1.4亿美元，公司计划建设737颗低地球轨道卫星组成通信网络。原文信息有限，建议阅读原文。
keyPoints: CesiumAstra获730万美元融资，估值4.5亿美元以上
